CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Winter-2015 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Winter-2015 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 1,355 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 16 benchmark sites in 3 regions spanning 3 states (survey period: June 2015 to June 2015). These surveys captured 38 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 11 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 1,619 cards across 89 sites, with 3% showing evidence of mouse activity (49 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 358 transects across 90 sites (survey period: June 2015 to July 2015), detecting active burrows in 7.8% of transects (total: 48 active burrows).
